welcome:
👋 Welcome to the Monad Buy Bot!

Track buys of any token on Monad — DEX-listed and incubation (bonding-curve) tokens — and get real-time alerts in this group.

Use /help to see all commands.
help:
📖 Commands:
/start — Welcome message and bot intro
/help — Show this help
/addtoken <address> — Track a token's buys in this group (admin)
/removetoken <address> — Stop tracking a token (admin)
/tokens — List tracked tokens
/setemoji <emoji> — Set custom buy alert emoji (admin)
/setwhaleemoji <emoji> — Set custom whale alert emoji (admin)
/setlanguage <en|es|zh> — Set group language (admin)
/setminbuy <MON> — Minimum buy amount to trigger alerts (admin)
/setwhale <MON> — Whale alert threshold in MON (admin)
/price [address] — Token price in MON/USD
/mcap [address] — Token market cap
/incubation [address] — Bonding-curve (incubation) progress
/stats — 24h buy stats for this group
/leaderboard — Top buyers in this group
/settings — Show current group settings
/about — About this bot
